Source contracts: src/smto_legal

src/smto_legal/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose immutable distribution legal resources without recording consent. _bundle verifies the named manifest payloads on first access and caches their exact bytes; document_bytes, version/hash accessors and usage_policy serve product/website/installer consumers. build/tools/legal_documents.py owns canonical generation and checks. Missing, malformed or changed resources fail before terms are returned; no controller or database is opened.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
document_bytes 42 Select a known resource; callers must never accept an arbitrary file path.
current_eula_version 49 Return the selected EULA version from the verified cached resource manifest; reading it does not record user acceptance.
license_version 55 Return the separately recorded License version from the verified cached manifest, preserving the explicit License/EULA version binding.
document_sha256 59 Not yet documented
usage_policy 63 Public licensing copy follows the selected canonical terms.
